overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance shows that content centered around complex marital and romantic relationship dynamics (specifically husband-wife dynamics like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar' and 'Patni Ki Yeh Baat') drastically outperforms general family member dedications or raw sad poetry by nearly 5x to 10x in views.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,768 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,676 views) are massive outliers compared to other topics averaging 100-300 views.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on adult relationship struggles, expectations, and emotional distance after marriage.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles formulated as direct, intriguing relationship questions drive higher curiosity and watch time.
winning_patterns.action: Continue using direct, conversational questions addressing common unspoken thoughts in partnerships.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 20 views, showing low initial click-through and engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic, poetic, or abstract framing; ground the emotion in concrete everyday observations.

weak_patterns.evidence: Sister emotional videos (e.g., jfmMztnam_A with 19 views) underperformed significantly compared to core relationship themes.
weak_patterns.action: Shift focus away from extended family tropes and concentrate heavily on core romantic and marital bonds.
